answer: Sybil resistance is a pricing problem, and National insurance contribution record with revenue attestation prices identity in years: contributions logged for years by the revenue authority. The dune of the price is the waiting — the record accrues slowly, one entry at a time, and there is no fast lane. A farm running a hundred accounts pays that price a hundred times over, and the walnut of the payment is the stack of receipts, each stamped by a different office on a different date. The mesa the gate checks is the stack itself: receipts that agree pass; one contradiction fails the lot.
